text:
natalie.partners: Heads-up  we need a compact SLA + fallback mapping for the upcoming H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi wave. Deliverable: one handed-off artifact that marketplace, SI, and ops can use.

igor-hw: I'll own HW validation outputs (signed firmware hash, kernel tag, bench power csv). Vendor note: NVIDIA microcode candidate possibly mid-Aug; may affect freeze.

felipe-prod: Marketplace wants a tile JSON + customer-facing fallback paragraph and an explicit SLA note (e.g., "best-effort fallback, latency may degrade by X"). Legal needs embargo start/end dates.

dani-devex: Devex will produce quickstarts + SI installer template + a canary test harness. Proposed canary smoke:
```
./ci_smoke --model "llama-13b" --seq 1024 --bs 1 --target_p50 130
```
Attach logs to sheet.

harper-oncall: Ops: routing pseudo-rule: 
`if cap(mi300_region) < 0.17 then prefer [h200_fallback,b200_fallback] else if p50_delta > 0.22 then prefer gaudi_compat_degraded`
We need explicit SLO downgrade messaging for canary and Dedicated customers.

natalie.partners: Owners: Igor->HW; Felipe->marketplace+embargo; Dani->devex+SI; Harper->ops routing; Natalie->press+handoff doc. Draft sheet by Tue EOD, full cert artifacts by Fri.

igor-hw: I'll DM vendor reps after this thread (NVIDIA: maria@nvidia, Habana: raj@habana, AMD: lucas@amd) and update freeze windows.

felipe-prod: Marketplace snippet example: `{"sku":"rw-mi300-64g","fallback":"H200/B200 may be used when MI300 is constrained. Expect 10-35% latency regression.","embargo":{"start":"2026-08-15","end":"2026-08-19"}}`

dani-devex: SI installer note: `install.sh --mode si --verify-bench`; rollback criteria: abort if p50 > 220ms for 20m. I'll open PR for quickstart + CI job `ci/marketplace/mi300-gaudi/smoke`.

harper-oncall: Filed INFRA-5401 for `lab-image: power-profile-v6` (thermal repro). Also adding playbook bullet: auto-fallback window = 10min grace, manual escalation if >30min.

natalie.partners: Recap action items and owners posted. Scheduling 20m sync Wed 09:30 to confirm embargo + canary windows. Please update the "HW-Roadmap-HandOffs" sheet and flag vendor slips immediately. :calendar: :thumbsup:

notify-bot: Reminder: Meeting Wed 09:30 "HW wave SLA + fallback check" (20m).
